risk_note: RV2 settlement (settlement-plan B2-04j, S1; BR-FUND-01, 02, 03, 04, 06, 07; decision 43). Creates the settlement module and implements the rebate ports orders already declares (onImported / onUpdated / onUnmappedStatus): R1, R2, R3a, R4 (writes settle_period and received_synced_at without overwriting), R6, R7 and the UNMAPPED_STATUS system hold, each decided in memory first and written through the generated order-rebate transition() with a version CAS in the caller's transaction. Locked orders (VOID / CREDITED / CLAWED_BACK) take platform progress as a logged no-op per the BR-FUND-01 order-lock rule (decision 43); IllegalTransition only for out-of-table commands. Whenever a settled commission is present the effective base (settlement first) is compared before and after through the estimates port: positive to zero voids (R6), any other change recomputes (R7), unchanged with only the estimate moving is archived (money rounds 1-2). No balance or voucher writes; not wired into orders/worker-runtime.ts (B2-04zb).
